title: What Is Accounting?
description: Understand what accounting does and why businesses need it.
html:
What is accounting?

Accounting is the process of recording, organizing, summarizing, and analyzing financial information.

Businesses use accounting to understand what they own, what they owe, how much they earn, and how much they spend.

Simple Example

You start a business and invest $10,000 of your own money.

The business now has $10,000 of cash and the owner has $10,000 of equity.

Why is accounting important?

Accounting helps owners, investors, lenders, managers, governments, and other users make financial decisions.

Key Points

  • Accounting tracks financial activity.
  • It helps measure profit and loss.
  • It shows what a business owns and owes.
  • It supports financial decision-making.
  • It provides information used in financial statements.
